bio.text: Charles Van Morgan is an independent candidate for governor of Tennessee in 2026, listed among the 13 independents on the ballot by the Nashville Banner.

In a letter to voters signed by Charles Van Morgan and published on the Daughter of Tennessee Substack, he describes himself as an 18-year commissioned law enforcement officer and Tennessee Highway Patrol veteran.
In the same letter he says he runs Unbridled News, a YouTube channel.
